feeding_claim.verbatim: Our beef are Grass fed year round from our own lush pastures.

notes: Sells quarter and half beef ($7.95/lb hanging weight, Jan 2026) and half pigs ($7.15/lb, 2026) by phone or email; meat is collected frozen at pickup. Pigs are fed fruits, vegetables, food scraps and grain. Homepage lists a service area (Ellington, Tolland, Vernon, Broad Brook, South Windsor, Enfield, Windsor Locks, plus CT, MA, RI) but no page says it delivers or ships, so none recorded; Verifier to check. No finishing statement for beef.
